headline: Infinity-Parser2: New Multimodal Model for End-to-End Document Parsing with SOTA Performance
reasoning: This is a highly relevant AI research paper detailing a new large multimodal model for document parsing. It introduces significant advancements in data synthesis, multi-task reinforcement learning, and achieves state-of-the-art results on established benchmarks, indicating a meaningful breakthrough in a practical AI application. The publication on arXiv from a team of researchers lends strong technical credibility.
summary: Researchers have released Infinity-Parser2, a large multimodal model for end-to-end document parsing, featuring a controllable data-synthesis pipeline and multi-task reinforcement learning. It achieves state-of-the-art performance on document parsing benchmarks and includes a new 5-million-sample bilingual corpus, Infinity-Doc2-5M.
